effect.lifedebt.life_debt.description: For the duration, fatal damage triggers a Totem of Undying effect and grants or strengthens Strength. Each death resisted stacks damage reduction and grants knockback resistance equal to that reduction (up to 100%). When the effect ends, max health is reduced by your death count during the buff; this penalty is removed after you respawn.
advancements.lifedebt.burn_out_body.desc: Burned yourself out in endless revival.
lifedebt.message.signed: Life Debt signed — you may cheat death %1$s more times.
lifedebt.message.signed_contract: %1$s signed — you may cheat death %2$s more times.
lifedebt.screen.contract.title: Sign a Life Debt Contract
lifedebt.message.repaid: Debt repaid. Remaining borrowed lives: %1$s; debt: %2$s
lifedebt.message.repay_need_xp: You need %1$s experience levels to repay with a Totem.
lifedebt.message.no_debt: You have no borrowed life to repay.
lifedebt.message.repay_hint: Hold a Debt Voucher or Totem of Undying to repay at the altar.
lifedebt.message.starter_bond: A mysterious bond has appeared in your inventory. You may, of your own free will, strike a pact with the Reaper — power now, paid for with lives later. Use it anytime to view the contracts.
lifedebt.message.sign_need_totem: Signing a pact requires a Totem of Undying as the offering.
lifedebt.message.soul_pay: Soul Pact: paid %1$s experience levels and cancelled this borrowed life's debt.
lifedebt.message.soul_poor: Soul Pact: nothing left to pay with — the cost of borrowing stands.
lifedebt.message.soul_pay_item: Soul Pact: consumed a Debt Voucher and cancelled this borrowed life's debt.
lifedebt.message.soul_pay_durability: Soul Pact: drew %1$s durability from your armor and cancelled this borrowed life's debt.
lifedebt.message.escape: Escape Pact: you slipped into the shadows and escaped for now.
lifedebt.message.villager_price: Word of your debt spreads — villagers are raising their prices against you.
lifedebt.message.assets_seized: The debt seizes %1$s experience levels and your provisions.
lifedebt.message.death_sentence: The debt issues a death sentence.
